component.name: James
component.summary: Desktop AI companion that asks before it touches anything

description.p: James talks to an AI model running on your own computer, through LM Studio, Ollama, llama.cpp or another OpenAI-compatible server. It connects only to that app on this computer and has no internet connection of its own.

ul.li: Guided first-run setup that ends with a real reply from your model
Shows your screen to a vision model only when you ask
Talk and dictation with tools on this computer
Read-only view of R.A.I.N. Lab research results

description.p: James is an early preview. Answers come from the model you choose and can be wrong.

screenshot.caption: A conversation with a model running on the same computer

description.p: Guided setup, model capability checks, Markdown replies, themes and accessibility settings, privacy controls and safer reviewed input.
